Subject: Ulvara Auto Care - Referral Required

Hi Celia,

Thanks for the submission on Ulvara Auto Care. I've reviewed the information and have everything needed to move forward.

However, this risk requires referral to our senior underwriting team for the following reasons:

• Auto care/service facilities require additional review under our guidelines
• The location falls within our coastal exposure zone (within 16 km of coast)
• We have significant accumulated values in this area that require capacity management

I'm forwarding this to my manager today and should have a response within 2-3 business days. If it's outside our appetite at this level, I can suggest some specialty markets that focus on coastal auto risks.

I'll be in touch soon.

Best regards,
[Underwriter name]
